lemmas.primary_translation: do the hardest share of the work

definitions.text: (etter Matt 20,12) opphavlig: utføre et slitsomt dagsverk; nå: være den som har mest slit, strev med noe
definitions.translation: (after Matthew 20:12) originally: perform an arduous day's work; now: be the one who has the most hard work and trouble with something (lit. bear the burden and heat of the day)
